subject: Possibility of hooking shinyapps up with a dedicated domain name

messages.author: 4f971f3a75d71f2f
messages.subject: Possibility of hooking shinyapps up with a dedicated domain name
parts:
Hi,

Are you open to letting people link shinyapps to dedicated domain names?

For example through a namecheap service.

Thanks,

-Evan

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Possibility of hooking shinyapps up with a dedicated domain name
parts:
Evan,

This is something that is possible with a service like namecheap. However, you will need to use a URL redirect rather then a CNAME. Using a CNAME to white label applications will be supported in the "Pro" tier for ShinyApps.

Thanks
-Andy
